metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature, captured with MODIS Terra, in New York higher on July 20-27, 2016 than the 2001-2010 average for the same period?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Collection: Primary MODIS/061/MOD11A1 (Terra LST Daily), fallback MODIS/061/MOD11A2 (Terra LST 8-day).
- Date: Compare July 20-27, 2016 to the same period for each year 2001–2010.
- Location: State of New York from TIGER/2018/States (NAME = "New York").

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask using QC_Day: keep pixels where bits 0-1 < 2 (LST produced; excludes cloud and non-produced).
- Also mask LST_Day_1km > 0. Convert to Celsius using scale 0.02 and -273.15.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collection sizes; if 0, fallback to A2; if still 0 -> C1.
- After masking, compute valid pixel count; if 0 -> C2.
- If mean is null/NaN -> C3.
- Otherwise compare 2016 mean vs 2001–2010 average.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const scale = 1000;
    const stateFc = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States');
    const ny = stateFc.filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'New York')).geometry();
    const periodStart2016 = '2016-07-20';
    const periodEnd2016 = '2016-07-28'; // end exclusive
    const baselineYears = ee.List.sequence(2001, 2010);

    // Helper: QC-based mask and Celsius conversion
    function toLST_C(img) {
      const lst = img.select('LST_Day_1km');
      const qc = img.select('QC_Day');
      // bits 0-1: 0 or 1 -> produced; 2 cloud; 3 other fail
      const produced = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).lt(2);
      const lstValid = lst.gt(0);
      const mask = produced.and(lstValid);
      return lst.multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15).updateMask(mask).rename('LST_C')
               .copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
    }

    async function getPeriodStats(start, end) {
      const products = ['MODIS/061/MOD11A1', 'MODIS/061/MOD11A2']; // prefer daily, fallback 8-day
      let usedProduct = null;
      let imgCount = 0;
      let lstMean = null;

      for (const prod of products) {
        const col = ee.ImageCollection(prod).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(ny);
        imgCount = await col.size().getInfo();
        if (imgCount > 0) {
          usedProduct = prod;
          const lstCol = col.map(toLST_C).select('LST_C');
          lstMean = lstCol.mean();
          break;
        }
      }

      if (!usedProduct) {
        return {status: 'C1', usedProduct: null, imgCount: 0};
      }

      // Valid pixel count and mean
      const validDict = lstMean.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: ny,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      const totalDict = ee.Image(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: ny,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      const meanDict = lstMean.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: ny,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });

      const validPx = await ee.Number(validDict.get('LST_C')).getInfo();
      const totalPx = await ee.Number(totalDict.get('one')).getInfo();
      const meanC = await ee.Number(meanDict.get('LST_C')).getInfo();

      if (validPx === null || totalPx === null) {
        return {status: 'C3', usedProduct, imgCount};
      }
      if (validPx === 0) {
        return {status: 'C2', usedProduct, imgCount, validPx, totalPx};
      }
      if (meanC === null || isNaN(meanC)) {
        return {status: 'C3', usedProduct, imgCount, validPx, totalPx};
      }

      return {status: 'OK', usedProduct, imgCount, validPx, totalPx, meanC};
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    console.log('Region: New York (TIGER/2018/States); Scale: 1000 m; Period: Jul 20-27');

    const stats2016 = await getPeriodStats(periodStart2016, periodEnd2016);
    if (stats2016.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(`2016 Status: ${stats2016.status}; Images: ${stats2016.imgCount || 0}`);
      const tag = stats2016.status; // C1/C2/C3
      if (tag === 'C1') console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).');
      else if (tag === 'C2') console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels (Images exist, but after cloud masking/processing, 0 pixels remain).');
      else if (tag === 'C3') console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Result is None/NaN/invalid).');
      console.log(tag);
      return;
    }
    const cloudPct2016 = 100 * (1 - stats2016.validPx / stats2016.totalPx);
    console.log(`2016 -> Product: ${stats2016.usedProduct.split('/').pop()}, Images: ${stats2016.imgCount}, ValidPx: ${stats2016.validPx}/${stats2016.totalPx} (${cloudPct2016.toFixed(1)}%), Mean LST: ${stats2016.meanC.toFixed(2)} °C`);

    // Baseline 2001-2010
    let yearsUsed = 0;
    let sumMeans = 0;
    let sumImgs = 0;
    let validRatios = [];
    for (let y = 2001; y <= 2010; y++) {
      const s = `${y}-07-20`;
      const e = `${y}-07-28`;
      const st = await getPeriodStats(s, e);
      if (st.status === 'OK') {
        yearsUsed += 1;
        sumMeans += st.meanC;
        sumImgs += st.imgCount;
        validRatios.push(st.validPx / st.totalPx);
      } else if (st.status === 'C2') {
        sumImgs += st.imgCount || 0;
      }
    }

    if (yearsUsed === 0) {
      // Distinguish C1 vs C2 for baseline
      // Check if any images existed at all using daily product rough check (one sample year)
      const anyColSize = await ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1')
        .filterDate('2005-07-20', '2005-07-28').filterBounds(ny).size().getInfo();
      const tag = anyColSize > 0 ? 'C2' : 'C1';
      console.log(`Baseline Status: ${tag}; Years used: 0/10; Images: ${sumImgs}`);
      console.log(tag);
      return;
    }

    const baselineMean = sumMeans / yearsUsed;
    const avgValidPct = 100 * (validRatios.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / yearsUsed);
    console.log(`Baseline (2001-2010) -> Years used: ${yearsUsed}/10, Images: ${sumImgs}, Avg Valid: ${avgValidPct.toFixed(1)}%, Mean LST: ${baselineMean.toFixed(2)} °C`);

    // 3. Calculation & Final Decision
    const delta = stats2016.meanC - baselineMean;
    console.log(`Delta (2016 - baseline): ${delta.toFixed(2)} °C`);
    if (!isFinite(delta)) {
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Result is None/NaN/invalid).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    if (delta > 0) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
